messages:
emma: FYI, ACME is seeing a spike of 429s on their Dedicated pool quiet-pool-2 starting ~11:30 UTC. They say traffic didn't change. Ticket: #T-12847
raj: looking. any recent deploys to quota service? :mag_right:
ops-bot: deploy finished: quota-service v3.7.2 by javier at 11:18 UTC (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:
sophia: I can see a sync job for tenant quotas ran at 11:19 as well. pulling logs now.
raj: logs show a lot of REJECT in per-tenant rate limiter for tenant_id=acme-123
emma: customer note: "requests succeed then 2m later we hit 429s for low-volume endpoints"
raj: paste, but tl;dr: their tokens are getting drained and not refilling due to pacing window config mismatch.
emma: can you show the limiter check snippet?
raj: sure — from quota-service logs:
```
limiter.check tenant=acme-123 pool=quiet-pool-2 allowed=false reason=burst_tokens_exhausted pacing_window=10s refill_rate=0.0
```
emma: pacing_window=10s? that seems short vs expected 60s for reserved pools.
sophia: agreed. looking at runtime config, quota-profile "starter-reserved" was overridden by a TF var in the PR that rolled out v3.7.2 — the var set `pacing_window_seconds = 10` and `burst_tokens = 0`. PR was meant for an internal test, but the var was leaked into env staging/prod via terraform workspace alias.
javier: I opened the PR (ops/terraform#842) to fix the var but the change landed mixed with autoscale flags earlier today. Sorry, that was my bad.
emma: ok, this explains behavior: low refill + tiny window => requests that used to spread over 60s now exhaust burst tokens quickly and cause per-tenant throttling despite Dedicated capacity.
raj: repro steps I used locally to simulate (do NOT run against prod):
```bash
# simulate burst from tenant for 90s at 20rps
python tools/send_rps.py --tenant acme-123 --pool quiet-pool-2 --rps 20 --duration 90
# check limiter metrics
curl -s "http://metrics.backend/limiter?tenant=acme-123&pool=quiet-pool-2" | jq .
```
emma: immediate mitigation?
sophia: rolling back TF change for that var in prod env. I also triggered quota-service restart on the few nodes that picked the bad config (some nodes still had old config).
ops-bot: rollback started: terraform apply --var-file=prod.tfvars (plan id: plan-9012)
sophia: running sync job to force tenant profile refresh: `/scripts/sync-tenant-quotas --tenant acme-123 --pool quiet-pool-2`
raj: after sync, limiter logs show pacing_window=60s and burst_tokens=120 for that profile. Allowed rates are back.
emma: ACME confirmed recovery at 11:42 UTC, 429s dropped to baseline. customer updated the ticket: "looks good, thanks" :white_check_mark:
javier: adding a guard in CI to prevent non-env-specific overrides from landing (PR incoming).
raj: follow-ups: 1) add alert if quota_profile differs across nodes for same pool/tenant 2) add integration test that validates pacing_window >= 30s for reserved profiles 3) run a scan for prod configs with burst_tokens <= 0.
emma: thanks team. I'll update ticket #T-12847 with root cause + timeline and CC customer success. Closing once postmortem note is added.
ops-bot: incident-note created: incidents/2026-11-09-quiet-pool-pacing-window.json
